description:
About Deputy

Deputy is a global SaaS workforce management company with hubs in Sydney, Melbourne, San Francisco and London, plus team members working remotely across the United States. Our platform serves over 1.5 million workers and 375,000 workplaces across 100+ countries. We are backed by top global investors and recently achieved Unicorn status. 
 
At Deputy, we’re improving the world of work, one shift at a time, for 80% of the world’s workforce: hourly workers. These are the dedicated employees who keep our world running – from baristas to nurses, cleaners to delivery drivers, florists to factory workers. Despite their vital role in society, most workplace technology has focused on those workers who sit behind a desk, but at Deputy, we transform the frontline. When businesses use Deputy, their workplaces thrive – the business is more profitable, compliant, and productive, while the workers are more engaged and happier at work.
 
We're becoming an AI-native company, a commitment that means you'll be empowered (and expected) to use AI tools and thinking in your day-to-day work. You'll have the training, support, and freedom to use AI responsibly and creatively to spark ideas, solve problems faster, and unlock new ways of working.

lists.content:
We’re looking for creative interns to join our Creative Team and help bring social content ideas to life. This role is perfect for someone who loves internet culture, short-form video, YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, trends, memes, storytelling, and making fun, awesome content with a team.

As a Creative Team Intern, you’ll support the day-to-day creative production process for social media. You’ll help with brainstorming, organizing, producing, editing, publishing, and improving content across our channels. You’ll also support practical channel maintenance tasks, including cleaning up and organizing YouTube channels, playlists, titles, descriptions, thumbnails, and assets.

This is a paid three-month contract working three days per week. There’s flexibility around which three days you work.

• You’re genuinely excited by social media, internet culture, and creative content.

  • You enjoy making things and want to learn how great social content gets produced.

  • You’re open to jumping into the creative process, whether that means brainstorming ideas, helping on shoots, capturing behind-the-scenes moments, or occasionally appearing in content when it feels right.

  • You’re organized, proactive, and happy to jump into both creative and practical tasks.

  • You have a good eye for what feels fun, current, and engaging online.

  • You’re comfortable collaborating with a team and receiving feedback.

  • You’re curious, adaptable, and willing to learn new tools, platforms, and workflows.

lists.content:
• Collaboration on Cross-Functional Delivery: Coordinate with departments including Sales, Implementation, Finance, and RevOps to manage operational tasks that support project success, such as routing projects, provisioning, and customer transition management.

  • Sales-to-Implementation Readiness: Manage the handover of customers from the sales team to the delivery phase, ensuring all contractual obligations and deliverables are compliant before the project starts.

  • Implementation-to-Success Handovers: Ensure a complete and consistent handover of implementation projects to Customer Success, including an audit of the implementation consultant's project closeout activities. 

  • Management of Operational Systems: Oversee the administration of Professional Services tools, such as Toggl and Asana, ensuring precise data entry and process compliance through project provisioning, template upkeep, user permissions management, and the systematic archiving of finished work.

• 3–5 years of experience in Professional Services Operations, Delivery Operations, Project Coordination, or a similar operational support role within a SaaS or technology organization.

  • Expertise in managing and utilizing CRM and Project Management software, particularly Salesforce, Toggl, Asana, and any PSA systems.

  • Proficiency in Google Sheets or Excel, including maintaining capacity trackers, SLA reporting, and operational reporting.

  • Self-starter capable of managing routine operational tasks with high autonomy, ensuring rigorous data integrity and meeting all deadlines.

  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal abilities to engage with various stakeholders and uphold data compliance standards across the organization.

  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate multiple cross-functional initiatives simultaneously while maintaining strong attention to detail and operational discipline.

  • Experience preparing operational reports and maintaining data used to support leadership decision-making.

This range does not include any potential incentive programs, such as individual or organizational performance bonuses.

The Role

We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Professional Services Operations Coordinator to support the successful delivery of Professional Services engagements. This role partners cross-functionally to coordinate operational workflows, maintain project systems, prepare operational reporting, and support consistent execution of service delivery processes across the organization. The successful applicant will be someone who excels at maintaining order, enjoys ensuring team efficiency, and is dedicated to managing precise operational processes and data.

lists.content:
• Working independently to solve complex, highly ambiguous customer-facing problems.

  • Scope, specify, design, implement and deliver software solutions, applying modern industry best practices to deliver resilient, high-performance, high-quality, and scalable systems and applications.

  • Develop end-to-end solutions, writing clean and efficient code for front-end web applications and back-end services to deliver seamless user experiences.

  • Own the quality of your work by thoroughly testing your solutions, including writing automated tests.

  • Collaborate with the engineering and cross-functional stakeholders to determine requirements and deliver complex problems.

  • Write simple, efficient, self-documented, modular, high-quality code that follows best practices.

  • Investigate, debug and solve issues within a bounded context.

  • Provide coaching to junior team members across the entire SDLC.

• You are a skilful engineer with high standards and a passion for quality backed by 3+ years of related work experience.

  • You are customer-obsessed, always working to deliver solutions that give the best possible experience for customers.

  • You show a bias for action and have a demonstrated track record of delivering high-quality, scalable, and fault-tolerant software systems.

  • You have strong computer science fundamentals: algorithms and data structures.

  • You are programming language agnostic with proficiency in front-end (e.g. Javascript, modern frameworks like React/Vue) and back-end (e.g. PHP, Golang) development.

  • You have expertise in API design (REST & RPC)  and its frameworks. Including using protobuf, gRPC, OpenAPI

  • Experience building service-oriented architecture, microservices, and modern techniques and tools. Including using Docker, ECS, Lambda, SQS, Kinesis, etc

  • Experience in a few persistence, storage and caching mechanisms. Including MySQL, Redis, DynamoDB, S3, etc

• Manage and drive the full sales cycle: prospecting, qualification, discovery, demo, negotiation, and close.

  • Manage opportunities passed from SDRs and progress them through the sales cycle.

  • Run discovery calls using the MEDDPICC framework to understand customer challenges and requirements.

  • Stay informed on industry trends and market dynamics to position yourself as an informed and trusted advisor to customers

  • Deliver compelling, tailored product demos to key stakeholders.

  • Manage deal negotiations and close new business to achieve monthly and quarterly targets.

  • Collaborate with SDRs on pipeline building and nurturing prospects.

  • Maintain accurate deal information, forecasting, and activity tracking in CRM (Salesforce).

  • Partner with Customer Success to ensure smooth onboarding and handover of new customers.

  • Participate in ongoing sales training and coaching to sharpen skills and contribute to a high-performance culture.

• Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to engage prospects at multiple levels.

  • Consultative selling approach with strong discovery and qualification skills.

  • Negotiation skills and ability to manage objections effectively.

  • Organised and detail-oriented with good time management.

  • Resilient, target-driven, and motivated by personal and team success.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth tech scale-up environment.

descriptionBody:
Role Overview

As an Account Executive at Deputy, you will own the full sales cycle from prospecting to close. You’ll work closely with prospects to understand their workforce management challenges, demonstrate the value of Deputy’s solutions, and drive revenue growth. As a member of the sales team, you’ll work closely with other GTM functions, share best practices, and contribute to shaping sales strategy. This is a great opportunity for proven AE’s who are hungry for an exciting new opportunity with growth potential.
